decisive_items: Medical history was remarkable for hypertension
response.rationale: R2 uniquely integrates the hypertension history, severe blood pressure elevation, and left atrial enlargement into a coherent hypertensive heart disease diagnosis. R4 relies on nonspecific BNP elevation and left atrial enlargement without the hypertensive cause; R1 is only an isolated echo finding; R3 has no raw support spans and represents a rhythm complication rather than the underlying diagnosis.

rejected.why: Only cites left atrial enlargement, an echo finding, not a complete diagnosis.
No raw support spans supplied; atrial flutter is a rhythm finding and lacks raw evidence in this candidate.
